description: This file implements a SOAP server for vtiger CRM, providing web service functions for contact and lead management, session handling, and permission checks, specifically tailored for integration with Thunderbird.

classes.name: Contacts
classes.description: Class representing contact entities in vtiger CRM, used for searching and retrieving contact data.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: Class managing user authentication and retrieval of user information.

classes.name: Emails
classes.description: Class for handling email record creation and relationships in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: SearchContactsByEmail
methods.description: Searches for contacts by email address, returning a list of contact details.

methods.name: track_email
methods.description: Logs email sending activity and creates email records linked to contacts and users.

methods.name: GetContacts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of contacts for the authenticated user.

methods.name: retrieve_account_id
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an account ID based on account name.

methods.name: AddContact
methods.description: Creates a new contact record in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: AddLead
methods.description: Creates a new lead record in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Creates a new user session after authentication.

methods.name: CheckContactPerm
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit contacts.

methods.name: CheckContactEmailPerm
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to access contact emails.

methods.name: CheckContactViewPerm
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to view contacts.

methods.name: CheckLeadViewPerm
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to view leads.
